title: Travel 2

intro.title: You already know

rows: journey · tour · tourist · abroad · foreign · guide · souvenir · hostel · luggage · backpack · booking
airline · terminal · railway · seat · passenger · coach · boarding pass · platform · delay · connection · route · ferry · check in

intro.note: Travel 1 gave you the trip and the paperwork; Transport gave you the flight, the fare and the gate. This unit is what goes wrong on the way, and where you stay.
intro.note_cz: Travel 1 dal cestu a doklady; Transport let, jízdné a odletovou bránu. Tato lekce je o tom, co se cestou pokazí, a o ubytování.

intro.title: You will use these words in

sentences.en: We had to cancel the trip because my daughter was ill.
sentences.cz: Museli jsme ten výlet zrušit, protože byla dcera nemocná.
accepts: We had to cancel the trip because my daughter was ill

sentences.en: The accommodation was cheaper than the hotel we found online.
sentences.cz: Ubytování bylo levnější než hotel, který jsme našli na internetu.
accepts: The accommodation was cheaper than the hotel we found online

sentences.en: Travel insurance is cheaper if you buy it before the holiday starts.
sentences.cz: Cestovní pojištění je levnější, když si ho koupíš před začátkem dovolené.
accepts: Travel insurance is cheaper if you buy it before the holiday starts

sentences.en: We waited at baggage claim for an hour because our bags were on a later flight.
sentences.cz: U výdeje zavazadel jsme čekali hodinu, protože naše zavazadla letěla pozdějším letem.
accepts: We waited at baggage claim for an hour because our bags were on a later flight

sentences.en: Passport control took longer than we expected.
sentences.cz: Pasová kontrola trvala déle, než jsme čekali.
accepts: Passport control took longer than we expected

sentences.en: The transfer from the airport was included in the price we paid.
sentences.cz: Přesun z letiště byl zahrnutý v ceně, kterou jsme zaplatili.
accepts: The transfer from the airport was included in the price we paid

sentences.en: Car hire at the station is cheaper than a taxi from the airport.
sentences.cz: Půjčovna aut na nádraží je levnější než taxi z letiště.
accepts: Car hire at the station is cheaper than a taxi from the airport

sentences.en: If we walk slowly, we will miss the train.
sentences.cz: Když půjdeme pomalu, zmeškáme vlak.
accepts: If we walk slowly, we will miss the train
If we walk slowly, we'll miss the train

sentences.en: Tourists often get lost in the old town.
sentences.cz: Turisté se ve starém městě často ztratí.
accepts: Tourists often get lost in the old town

sentences.en: She wrote to the airline twice, but her lost luggage never arrived.
sentences.cz: Napsala aerolinkám dvakrát, ale její ztracené zavazadlo nikdy nedorazilo.
accepts: She wrote to the airline twice, but her lost luggage never arrived

sentences.en: My son gets travel sick if he reads on the bus.
sentences.cz: Můj syn má cestovní nevolnost, když v autobuse čte.
accepts: My son gets travel sick if he reads on the bus

sentences.en: When the strike stopped every train, we drove to Brno by car.
sentences.cz: Když stávka zastavila všechny vlaky, jeli jsme do Brna autem.
accepts: When the strike stopped every train, we drove to Brno by car

sentences.en: The airport was closed on Sunday morning because of bad weather.
sentences.cz: Letiště bylo v neděli ráno zavřené kvůli špatnému počasí.
accepts: The airport was closed on Sunday morning because of bad weather

sentences.en: Her phone was stolen on the night bus.
sentences.cz: Telefon jí ukradli v nočním autobuse.
accepts: Her phone was stolen on the night bus

sentences.en: We asked for a double room that was quieter than the first one.
sentences.cz: Požádali jsme o dvoulůžkový pokoj, který byl tišší než ten první.
accepts: We asked for a double room that was quieter than the first one

sentences.en: We had to check out early because our train left at seven.
sentences.cz: Museli jsme se odhlásit brzy, protože nám v sedm jel vlak.
accepts: We had to check out early because our train left at seven

sentences.en: I always book a hotel with breakfast included when I travel for work.
sentences.cz: Vždycky si rezervuju hotel se snídaní v ceně, když cestuju za prací.
accepts: I always book a hotel with breakfast included when I travel for work

sentences.en: We could not stay at the campsite near the lake because it was full.
sentences.cz: Nemohli jsme zůstat v kempu u jezera, protože byl plný.
accepts: We could not stay at the campsite near the lake because it was full

sentences.en: They stayed in a small guest house because the hotels were all full.
sentences.cz: Bydleli v malém penzionu, protože hotely byly všechny plné.
accepts: They stayed in a small guest house because the hotels were all full

sentences.en: The wifi in the room stopped working at night.
sentences.cz: Wifi na pokoji v noci přestala fungovat.
accepts: The wifi in the room stopped working at night

sentences.en: We paid a deposit when we booked the flat.
sentences.cz: Když jsme si zamluvili byt, zaplatili jsme zálohu.
accepts: We paid a deposit when we booked the flat

sentences.en: The receptionist gave us a map and showed us where the station was.
sentences.cz: Recepční nám dal mapu a ukázal nám, kde je nádraží.
accepts: The receptionist gave us a map and showed us where the station was

use_hint: Rewrite the sentence. Replace the underlined words.

use_sentences.prompt: They are going to stop the flight because of the snow.
use_sentences.en: They are going to cancel the flight because of the snow.
accepts: They are going to cancel the flight because of the snow

use_sentences.prompt: We found cheap places to stay in Rome.
use_sentences.en: We found cheap accommodation in Rome.
accepts: We found cheap accommodation in Rome

use_sentences.prompt: We always lose our way in the old town.
use_sentences.en: We always get lost in the old town.
accepts: We always get lost in the old town

use_sentences.prompt: The woman at the desk gave us the keys.
use_sentences.en: The receptionist gave us the keys.
accepts: The receptionist gave us the keys

use_sentences.prompt: You must leave the room and give the key back before eleven.
use_sentences.underline: leave the room and give the key back
use_sentences.en: You must check out before eleven.
accepts: You must check out before eleven

use_sentences.prompt: Before the trip we bought cover for problems and illness.
use_sentences.en: Before the trip we bought insurance.
accepts: Before the trip we bought insurance
Before the trip we bought travel insurance

use_sentences.prompt: We will not catch the train.
accepts: We will miss the train

use_sentences.prompt: We paid some money first and the rest later.
use_sentences.en: We paid a deposit and the rest later.
accepts: We paid a deposit and the rest later
